action.description: call: one desktop helper chain; run: a JavaScript body; capabilities: host report; close: end the session

method.description: desktop helper name, e.g. screenshot, window, click, clipboard.read

chain.description: call (required): one desktop helper call, optionally followed by one call on the window/element it returns

code.description: run (required): JavaScript async function body; `desktop`, `wait`, `assert`, `tool` in scope; `return` sets the value

read_only.description: run: true = inspection only: screenshots and AX reads, input/mutation blocked

action.description: The action to perform, or batch to run `actions` in order

x.description: click, double_click, move, drag (start), scroll (required): x pixel

y.description: click, double_click, move, drag (start), scroll (required): y pixel

button.description: click, double_click, move, drag: mouse button (default left)

scroll_x.description: scroll (required): horizontal scroll distance in pixels on every OS (one wheel notch is about 40 px); positive scrolls right

scroll_y.description: scroll (required): vertical scroll distance in pixels on every OS (one wheel notch is about 40 px); positive moves the view toward the end of the content (down)

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds for this action.

include_screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot after the action.
